lines.text: Lesson fifteen: 1-minute, 5-minute and 15-minute timeframes.
lines.say: Lesson fifteen: one-minute, five-minute and fifteen-minute timeframes.

lines.text: Same market, grouped in different time windows.
lines.say: Same market, grouped in different time windows.

lines.text: Here are fifteen minutes of a fictional BTC chart, one candle per minute.
lines.say: Here are fifteen minutes of a fictional B-T-C chart, one candle per minute.

lines.text: Tap 5m: now there are three candles. Tap 15m: just one.
lines.say: Tap five-minute: now there are three candles. Tap fifteen-minute: just one.

lines.text: Did the market change? No. Only the way it is grouped.
lines.say: Did the market change? No. Only the way it is grouped.

lines.text: That grouping is called a timeframe.
lines.say: That grouping is called a timeframe.

lines.text: A timeframe is how much time each candle covers.
lines.say: A timeframe is how much time each candle covers.

lines.text: On a 1-minute chart, each candle is one minute. On a 5-minute chart, five.
lines.say: On a one-minute chart, each candle is one minute. On a five-minute chart, five.

lines.text: Like a diary: notes for each day, a summary each week, one for the month.
lines.say: Like a diary: notes for each day, a summary each week, one for the month.

lines.text: Same life, different summaries. Same trades, different candles.
lines.say: Same life, different summaries. Same trades, different candles.

lines.text: Let's build one 5-minute candle from five 1-minute candles.
lines.say: Let's build one five-minute candle from five one-minute candles.

lines.text: Open: the first minute's open. 60,000.
lines.say: Open: the first minute's open. Sixty thousand.

lines.text: High: the highest high of all five. That is 60,110, in minute four.
lines.say: High: the highest high of all five. That is sixty thousand one hundred ten, in minute four.

lines.text: Low: the lowest low of all five. 59,980, in the first minute.
lines.say: Low: the lowest low of all five. Fifty-nine thousand nine hundred eighty, in the first minute.

lines.text: Close: the last minute's close. 60,090.
lines.say: Close: the last minute's close. Sixty thousand ninety.

lines.text: Watch them merge: open 60,000, high 60,110, low 59,980, close 60,090.
lines.say: Watch them merge: open sixty thousand, high sixty thousand one hundred ten, low fifty-nine thousand nine hundred eighty, close sixty thousand ninety.

lines.text: It is green, because 60,090 closed above 60,000.
lines.say: It is green, because sixty thousand ninety closed above sixty thousand.

lines.text: Fifteen minutes works the same way. Take all fifteen 1-minute candles.
lines.say: Fifteen minutes works the same way. Take all fifteen one-minute candles.

lines.text: First open, 60,000. Highest high, 60,170. Lowest low, 59,920.
lines.say: First open, sixty thousand. Highest high, sixty thousand one hundred seventy. Lowest low, fifty-nine thousand nine hundred twenty.

lines.text: Last close, 60,150. One green 15-minute candle.
lines.say: Last close, sixty thousand one hundred fifty. One green fifteen-minute candle.

lines.text: The three 5-minute candles give the same answer. The maths always agrees.
lines.say: The three five-minute candles give the same answer. The maths always agrees.

lines.text: Now one chart, one time axis. Under it all, the same price path.
lines.say: Now one chart, one time axis. Under it all, the same price path.

lines.text: Switch to 1-minute: fifteen narrow candles sit on the path.
lines.say: Switch to one-minute: fifteen narrow candles sit on the path.

lines.text: Switch to 5-minute: they merge into three wider ones.
lines.say: Switch to five-minute: they merge into three wider ones.

lines.text: Switch to 15-minute: one candle for the whole stretch.
lines.say: Switch to fifteen-minute: one candle for the whole stretch.

lines.text: The path never moved. Only the grouping changed.
lines.say: The path never moved. Only the grouping changed.

lines.text: Short timeframes show every small back-and-forth. That is called noise.
lines.say: Short timeframes show every small back-and-forth. That is called noise.

lines.text: On the 1-minute chart, 10:05 to 10:07 looks like a big drop.
lines.say: On the one-minute chart, ten oh five to ten oh seven looks like a big drop.

lines.text: On the 15-minute view, that drop is just a dip inside one green candle.
lines.say: On the fifteen-minute view, that drop is just a dip inside one green candle.

lines.text: A signal is a change big enough to stand out from the noise. It is still no promise.
lines.say: A signal is a change big enough to stand out from the noise. It is still no promise.

lines.text: Higher-timeframe context: check the bigger view first.
lines.say: Higher-timeframe context: check the bigger view first.

lines.text: Like a map: zoom out to see the city, then zoom in to find the street.
lines.say: Like a map: zoom out to see the city, then zoom in to find the street.

lines.text: Look at 15m for the big picture, then 5m and 1m for detail.
lines.say: Look at fifteen-minute for the big picture, then five-minute and one-minute for detail.

lines.text: If the views disagree, that is a reason to be careful, or to wait.
lines.say: If the views disagree, that is a reason to be careful, or to wait.

lines.text: A common mistake: averaging the 1-minute highs to get the 5-minute high.
lines.say: A common mistake: averaging the one-minute highs to get the five-minute high.

lines.text: The average of these five highs is 60,060. That is wrong.
lines.say: The average of these five highs is sixty thousand sixty. That is wrong.

lines.text: The 5-minute high is the highest of them: 60,120. Price really reached it.
lines.say: The five-minute high is the highest of them: sixty thousand one hundred twenty. Price really reached it.

lines.text: Open is first, close is last, high is highest, low is lowest. No averages.
lines.say: Open is first, close is last, high is highest, low is lowest. No averages.

lines.text: Your turn. Here are five 1-minute candles, from 10:10 to 10:14.
lines.say: Your turn. Here are five one-minute candles, from ten ten to ten fourteen.

lines.text: What are the 5-minute open, high, low and close? Pause if you need time.
lines.say: What are the five-minute open, high, low and close? Pause if you need time.

lines.text: Open 60,010, the first open. Close 60,150, the last close.
lines.say: Open sixty thousand ten, the first open. Close sixty thousand one hundred fifty, the last close.

lines.text: High 60,170, the highest high. Low 59,990, the lowest low.
lines.say: High sixty thousand one hundred seventy, the highest high. Low fifty-nine thousand nine hundred ninety, the lowest low.

lines.text: A green 5-minute candle. Well done if you got all four.
lines.say: A green five-minute candle. Well done if you got all four.

lines.text: Quick check: is each one a change in the view, or a real market event?
lines.say: Quick check: is each one a change in the view, or a real market event?

lines.text: Switching timeframes and wider candles: just the view.
lines.say: Switching timeframes and wider candles: just the view.

lines.text: Trades and price moves are the market. The view only groups them.
lines.say: Trades and price moves are the market. The view only groups them.

lines.text: Before we move on, a few honest limits.
lines.say: Before we move on, a few honest limits.

lines.text: Shorter timeframes are noisier. More candles do not mean more good chances.
lines.say: Shorter timeframes are noisier. More candles do not mean more good chances.

lines.text: Trading every small move piles up fees and mistakes.
lines.say: Trading every small move piles up fees and mistakes.

lines.text: No timeframe predicts the future. WAIT and NO_TRADE are always allowed.
lines.say: No timeframe predicts the future. Wait and no trade are always allowed.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: A timeframe is how much time each candle covers.
lines.say: A timeframe is how much time each candle covers.

lines.text: To combine candles: first open, highest high, lowest low, last close.
lines.say: To combine candles: first open, highest high, lowest low, last close.

lines.text: Check the bigger view for context. Short timeframes are noisy.
lines.say: Check the bigger view for context. Short timeframes are noisy.

lines.text: Check yourself: five 1-minute candles, the last closes at 60,090. The 5-minute close?
lines.say: Check yourself: five one-minute candles, the last closes at sixty thousand ninety. The five-minute close?

lines.text: 60,090. The 5-minute close is always the last 1-minute close.
lines.say: Sixty thousand ninety. The five-minute close is always the last one-minute close.

lines.text: Great work! Next up: trend and market structure.
lines.say: Great work! Next up: trend and market structure.

lines.text: See you in lesson sixteen.
lines.say: See you in lesson sixteen.
